steps.en: A recipient mobile number or email field is shown
steps.id: Kolom nomor HP atau email penerima ditampilkan
steps.why_en: No form with a recipient field is reachable.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada form dengan kolom penerima yang bisa dibuka.

steps.en: Subject and message fields are shown
steps.why_en: Only the template editor has these fields, not a send screen.
steps.why_id: Hanya editor template yang punya kolom ini, bukan layar kirim.

steps.en: Send now or scheduled date and time fields are shown
steps.id: Kolom kirim sekarang atau jadwal tanggal/jam ditampilkan
steps.why_id: Tidak ada kolom jadwal di mana pun.

steps.en: The officer's input is validated and accepted by the system
steps.id: Input officer divalidasi dan diterima sistem
steps.why_en: No ad-hoc receiving logic exists; furnish replies need a case number.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logika terima ad-hoc; balasan furnish butuh nomor kasus.

steps.en: The SMS or email is sent as entered, now or scheduled
steps.id: SMS atau email terkirim sesuai input, sekarang atau terjadwal
steps.why_en: No ad-hoc sending or scheduling exists in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengiriman atau penjadwalan ad-hoc di code.
